summary: Eight metres of main-road kerb by a junction, signed no stopping.
reasons: Marked as no stopping any time

drivers.seclusion: Park frontage to the north, but it sits on a busy multi-lane road approach.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb stretch is 8 m with no pull-out; the van would sit in or beside a through lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial approach to a signalled junction with turn lanes.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; no parking lane marked.

flags: Low-lying: about 3.7 m elevation, Witton Creek 97 m away
Signs say No Stopping Any Time
sun_shade: Trees on the north side shade the kerb from the north and east.
